main.description: Check EVM addresses against the wallets Krao accounts verified: who owns each one, and which verified wallets of other accounts look like it (same first 4 and last 4 hex characters, a different address), a sign of address poisoning. Public and rate limited.

expectedDid.description: The account the caller believes the addresses belong to, eg a tip recipient.

results.description: One result per address, in the order given.

errors.name: InvalidAddress
errors.description: An address is not a 0x-prefixed 40 hex character EVM address.
